body:
## Problem

Repro:

`q:` to open the cmdwin, then:

```vim
:set nowinfixbuf
:enew
```

Now nvim thinks the cmdwin is open when it isn't, this causes problems with `:messages` rendering, `:chist`, etc

Or for a more obvious bug, then type:

```vim
:tabedit
:tabonly
```
So there's no possibility the cmdwin is open or sharing any open buffer.

But, `q:` --> `E1292: Command-line window is already open`

## Solution

Handle the cmdwin changing to other buffers

comment_data.body:
this is kinda pointless now, isn't it? if we are allowing the window to be reused for other purposes, there is no real reason to disallow clobbering the buffer itself. thus we might as well go all the way and delete this:

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/8d9a798d6d99c60d9434584d0d5dc38f3f57b2bd/src/nvim/eval/funcs.c#L3481-L3482

and delete `e_cmdwin`, and docs / .po files mentioning "E11" ?

the 'winfixbuf' constraint was the one remaining meaningful constraint. if we're removing that there is no point in having this final, random constraint.

`cmdwin.open()` creates a new buffer/window every time, so it's not like cmdwin.lua depends on anything being long-lived...

@@ -127,22 +126,42 @@ function M.open(type, init_line, init_col)
     end,
   })
 
+  -- Clean up when the cmdwin is swapped to another buffer
+  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ 'BufWinLeave' }, {
+    buffer = buf,
+    nested = true,
+    callback = function()
+      if state == nil then
+        return
+      end
+      -- We're the last cmdwin buffer (see BufWinLeave), so cleanup.
+      -- But don't delete the buffer, as the BufWinLeave code handles it.
+      M._cleanup { delbuf = false }
+      return true
+    end,
+  })
+
   vim.api.nvim_exec_autocmds('CmdwinEnter', { pattern = type, modeline = false })
 end
 
 --- @private
-function M._cleanup()
+--- @param opts? {delbuf?: boolean}
+function M._cleanup(opts)
   if state == nil then
     return
   end
   local s = state
   state = nil
   pcall(vim.api.nvim__cmdwin_set, '', 0) -- Clear the C-side globals.
   pcall(vim.api.nvim_exec_autocmds, 'CmdwinLeave', { pattern = s.type, modeline = false })
-  if vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(s.buf) then
+  if (opts == nil or opts.delbuf ~= false) and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(s.buf) then
     pcall(vim.api.nvim_buf_delete, s.buf, { force = true })
   end
-  if vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(s.caller_win) then
